experiments.title: Workload Characterization vs. Production BI Queries
experiments.scope: Paper §2.1, Table 1, and Figure 1: contrasts Amazon Redset production warehouse queries against 100 memoryless LLM data-agent sessions across 5 metrics on a 1M-row retail star schema (80.5% exploration/validation SQL).
experiments.raw_data: Aggregated SQL AST fingerprint statistics (`workload-stats.json`, `workload-stats.md`) and Amazon Redset warehouse statistics (`redset/redset_stats.json`).
experiments.code_record: `./target/release/mavra workload-bench --rows 1000000 --agent openai`; SQL AST fingerprinting via `pglast`.

experiments.title: Multi-Agent Population Sharing on TPC-DS SF1
experiments.scope: Paper §6.2 (Q1, Figure 6): 16 sequential data agents across 5 independent runs on TPC-DS SF1 plus append-only sales restatement, comparing `No memory`, `Single-agent memory`, `Example retrieval`, and `MAVRA`.
experiments.raw_data: Per-step cumulative token, SQL-call, database-time, and accuracy trajectories in `population-stats.json` and metric definitions in `tpcds-defs.json`.

experiments.title: Multi-Schema Generality: TPC-H, SSB, and BIRD Financial
experiments.scope: Paper §6.1 and §6.6 (Table 6): declarative schema manifests, verified metric libraries, SQL reference queries, and multi-schema sharing and maintenance summaries across TPC-H SF1, Star Schema Benchmark (SSB) SF1, and BIRD `financial`.
experiments.raw_data: Declarative schema manifests in `schemas/`, verified definition libraries in `libs/`, reference SQL in `queries/`, and aggregated summaries (`generality-stats.json`, `replay-safety-summary.json`, `e2e/scen-stats.json`).

experiments.title: Semantic Lookup Scaling (26 to 1,000 Definitions) and Selective Risk-Coverage
experiments.scope: Paper §4.3 and §6.3 (Q2, Table 3, Figure 8): nested enterprise metric catalogs ($M \in \{26, 100, 500, 1000\}$) across 8 domains on 390 main requests + 204 held-out paraphrases, comparing `Name match`, `Embedding top-1`, `TeCoD`, `Single CE (no diff)`, `Top-8 + LLM`, `MAVRA (0-retrain)`, and `MAVRA (refreshed)`.
experiments.raw_data: Nested catalogs (`catalog_26..1000.json`), request sets (`requests_*.json`), example pools (`pool_*.json`), disjoint synthetic training phrasings (`train_*.jsonl`), and aggregated scaling/risk-coverage summaries (`scale-summary.json`, `risk-coverage.json`).

experiments.title: End-to-End Maintenance Under 11 Database Updates
experiments.scope: Paper §6.4 (Q3, Figure 7, Table 4): 11 database updates across Synthetic Retail (1M rows) and TPC-H SF1 over 3 runs comparing `MAVRA` against `ACE`, `AWM`, `G-Memory`, `TeCoD`, `Shared recheck`, `Template + schema check`, and `Template + write invalidate`.
experiments.raw_data: Frozen question banks (`bank-synthetic.json`, `bank-tpch.json`) and aggregated per-cell, per-group, and per-change outcomes (`study-stats.json`).

experiments.title: Value Guards, Historical Repair Gate G9, Unseen Bindings, and Sustained Writes
experiments.scope: Paper §4.1, §4.4, §6.3, §6.4, and §6.6 (Tables 3, 4, 6): `NotNull` and `MeasureScale` value conditions, `G9` untouched-bucket historical check on 12-change replay (`reclass`), serving-vs-withholding split, 39-period unseen-binding generalization, 26-definition lookup confirmation, and 64-session sustained concurrent writes.
experiments.raw_data: 12-change guard replay outcomes (`replay-guards.json`), unseen-binding report (`binding-report.json`), serving split (`served-split.json`), lookup confirmation summaries (`lookup-confirm/`, `lookup-glm/`, `lookup-tecod/`), and sustained-write summary (`sustained/summary.json`).

experiments.title: Cross-Cutoff Predictive Feature Reuse on RelBench
experiments.scope: Paper §6.5 (Q4, Table 5): entity-level feature engineering across 5 temporal cutoffs on `rel-stack` and `rel-trial` with fixed LightGBM 4.6.0 protocol and mandatory leakage audit against `No memory`, `Single-agent memory`, `Example retrieval`, `ACE`, `AWM`, `G-Memory`, `TeCoD`, and `FeatPilot*`.
experiments.raw_data: Aggregated per-session validation/test scores, token/runtime breakdowns (`paper-sessions.json`), and cold-start vs. reuse work breakdown (`reuse-work-data.json`).
experiments.code_record: `python3 tools/relbench/prepare.py` and `python3 tools/relbench/harness.py --arm mavra-retry`; LightGBM 4.6.0 and row-level temporal audit.

experiments.title: Three-Run RelBench Evaluation and Cutoff-1 Refitting Attribution
experiments.scope: Paper §6.5 (Q4, Table 5): three-run repeated evaluation of `MAVRA` and `No memory` on `rel-stack` and `rel-trial`, pure cutoff-1 frozen-SQL refitting control across cutoffs 2–5, and per-task temporal shift attribution.
experiments.raw_data: Per-run audit summaries (`gate-r1.json`..`gate-r3.json`), frozen cutoff-1 refit evaluations (`frozen-rel-stack.json`, `frozen-rel-trial.json`, `frozen-summary.json`), and task-shift attribution (`shift-attribution.json`).

experiments.title: Condition Sharing, Snapshot Binding, and TPC-DS Replay
experiments.scope: Paper §6.2 and §6.6 (Table 6): evaluates condition sharing vs. generic SQL-text check caching, `REPEATABLE READ` snapshot-bound validation (`0 / 11,297` vs. `261` TOCTOU anomalies), 16-shard `mavra_versions` trigger throughput, `repair_unique` ambiguity safety, and 4-policy TPC-DS replay.
experiments.raw_data: Aggregated statistics for 1M/4M condition-sharing sweeps, snapshot-binding isolation, 16-shard trigger throughput, ambiguity safety, and TPC-DS replay (`*-stats.json`).
experiments.code_record: `cargo test --release --locked q5_bench_tests:: -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1` and `./target/release/mavra replay-bench --libs exp/population-sharing/tpcds-defs.json --schema tpcds`.

experiments.title: Publication Gates, Equivalence Optimization, and Premise Rollback
experiments.scope: Paper §4.2 and §6.6: evaluates publication admission gates `G1`–`G7`, equivalence-preserving revision optimization (`KeyRange` and `DateKeysContiguous`), and automatic rollback from `r1` to `r0` when out-of-order date keys invalidate optimization premises.
experiments.raw_data: Premise-invalidation rollback report (`premise-report.json`) and revision-optimization speedup summary (`opt-stats.md`).

experiments.title: Paired Fixed-Catalog Maintenance Policy Replay
experiments.scope: Paper §6.6 (Q5, Table 6): fixed-catalog paired replay across TPC-DS, TPC-H, SSB, and BIRD `financial` comparing `Write invalidate`, `Schema check only`, `Table-level data tests`, and `MAVRA` (`condition`) with exact-duplicate and date-key local repairs.
experiments.raw_data: Aggregated four-schema policy-replay contingency tables and per-change breakdowns (`replay-policies.json`).
experiments.code_record: `./target/release/mavra replay-bench --libs exp/multi-schema-generality/libs/<schema>.json --policies condition --oracles snapshot` and `python3 exp/policy-replay/analyse.py --tex results/gen/replay-policies.tex`.

experiments.title: Shared Validation Scaling Across 1 to 32 Concurrent Agents
experiments.scope: Paper §6.6 (Q5, Figure 9): post-update validation query counts and database time across 16 shared definitions and 1–32 staggered or simultaneous agents (3 randomized blocks = 108 cells), comparing `per-agent`, `full-recheck`, and `mavra`.
experiments.raw_data: Aggregated 108-cell validation query count and database runtime distributions across 1–32 agents (`stats.json`).

experiments.title: Controlled Mechanism Studies: Representation, Overlap, and TOCTOU Barrier
experiments.scope: Paper §6.6 (Q5): Part A $2 \times 2$ feature-definition vs. full-program reuse on `rel-stack`; Part B 72-cell fixed-catalog condition-overlap sweep ($k=1..8$) vs. SQL-text check cache; Part C 30-trial controlled-barrier TOCTOU snapshot isolation.
experiments.raw_data: Frozen source feature input (`source-input.json`), 8-cell factorial representation summary (`representation-summary.json`), and 72-cell overlap + 30-trial barrier summary (`system-summary.json`).

experiments.title: Warehouse Scale-Up (TPC-DS SF1/SF3/SF10) and Core Coverage
experiments.scope: Paper §6.5 and §6.6 (Q5): TPC-DS SF1/SF3/SF10 validation and repair scalability from 2.88M to 28.80M `store_sales` rows, 4-call budget-matched RelBench `No memory` truncation control, and static single-fact $N{:}1$ `G3` template coverage across four schemas.
experiments.raw_data: Aggregated SF1/SF3/SF10 validation/repair timings and row counts (`scaling-summary.json`), 4-call RelBench truncation summary (`relbench-4call-truncation.json`), and `G3` coverage summary (`g3-coverage.json`).
experiments.code_record: `./target/release/mavra --pool 16 replay-bench --libs exp/population-sharing/tpcds-defs.json --schema tpcds --tpcds-db tpcds_sf10 --policies revoke,schema,tabletest,condition --oracles snapshot`.
